researcher_notes: CALIBRATION RUN. This is the COMPANY-WIDE INFRASTRUCTURE/SOFTWARE example for this run: two documents describe DS Automotion's software stack (NAVIOS fleet manager + ARCOS onboard vehicle software), not any single vehicle -- 'Navios-OnePager-2025-DE.pdf' (2pp) and 'Planbare_Autonomie_Broschuere_DE.pdf' (12pp, 'ARCOS verbindet AGV und AMR'). Both explicitly and repeatedly state VDA 5050 compatibility as a headline feature ('Zentrale Intelligenz, VDA 5050 inklusive' / 'integrierte VDA 5050 Schnittstelle' / cover page badge 'VDA 5050 & LIF kompatibel'). No individual product datasheets were processed in this run for DS Automotion -- see coverage report for the many AMADEUS/AMY/ARNY/LUCY/OSCAR/SALLY one-pagers still sitting in New/ for a future batch. IMPORTANT FOR IMPORT: per the agent workflow, these company-wide fields are stored at Base-Model granularity in the schema, not at Company granularity -- they must be fanned out to EVERY DS Automotion base model (AMADEUS Classic/Counter/Grip/Low/Rack/Tugger/Wide, AMY Deck/Lift, ARNY Duplex/HD Triplex/Mono/Triplex, FLEXIHAULER, LUCY, OSCAR Omni/Omni XL/Spin 180/Spin 360, ROLLGANG Doppel/Mono, SALLY/Kurier/Rollgang) at import time, respecting the 'never overwrite non-null' rule per base model individually (some DS Automotion base models may already have these fields filled from a prior research batch and should not be blindly overwritten). ADDENDUM (continuation run, same calendar day): processed 8 one-pager files covering AMADEUS/AMY/ARNY/LUCY/OSCAR/SALLY. Almost all core KO fields (max_payload, lifting_height, max_speed) for these products were ALREADY comprehensively filled in a prior general research batch (not this agent's own earlier runs) and cross-checked cleanly against these one-pagers with no conflicts except where noted below.

field_sources.vda5050_compatible: NAVIOS onepager p.1 headline 'Zentrale Intelligenz, VDA 5050 inklusive' and body text 'Eine zuverlässige Einbindung von Fremdfahrzeugen ist durch die VDA 5050 problemlos möglich'; ARCOS brochure p.5 'integrierte VDA 5050 Schnittstelle' and back cover badge 'VDA 5050 & LIF kompatibel'
field_sources.fleet_management_system: same sources as above -- both NAVIOS (control tower) and ARCOS (onboard) are built around a standardised VDA5050 interface, explicitly stated to also communicate with THIRD-PARTY VDA5050 control towers, not only DS Automotion's own
field_sources.fleet_control_architecture: ARCOS brochure p.8 'kooperative Navigation ... ohne dabei auf ein zentrales Verkehrssteuerungssystem vertrauen zu müssen' (decentralized/cooperative intersection negotiation) combined with p.4/p.8 'in Verbindung mit dem Flottenmanager NAVIOS werden zudem auch gegenseitige Blockierungen verhindert' (central fleet manager still coordinates) -- read as Hybrid (decentralized reactive/cooperative navigation + centralized order/fleet management), not a fully centralized or fully decentralized architecture
field_sources.multi_fleet_capable: NAVIOS onepager p.1 'Eine zuverlässige Einbindung von Fremdfahrzeugen ist durch die VDA 5050 problemlos möglich' (reliable integration of third-party vehicles via VDA5050)
field_sources.autonomous_obstacle_bypass: ARCOS brochure p.5/p.6 'Hindernisse können effizient umfahren werden' and p.4 'Autonome Funktionen wie die freie Bahnplanung zum Umfahren von Hindernissen erhöhen die Flexibilität'
field_sources.integration_capability: NAVIOS onepager p.2 'Aufträge können ... über die Anbindung eines ERP-Systems' erzeugt werden -- only ERP is explicitly named; no SAP/MES/REST API/MQTT/OPC-UA/Modbus term appears anywhere in either document, so nothing else was added

company_wide_context.applies_to: all base models of this company (DS Automotion GmbH)
company_wide_context.notes: navigation_type was deliberately NOT included as a company-wide field despite ARCOS brochure p.9 listing 'Virtuell Spurgeführt / Teilautonom / Autonom' (Navigation) and 'Konturbasiert / Laser / Magnetgrid' (Lokalisierung) -- these terms don't map cleanly 1:1 onto the AP0 allowed_values list (['Laser Reflector','Natural Feature (SLAM)','Magnetic Tape','QR/DM Code','Contour','Inductive Loop','Vision']); 'Magnetgrid' in particular is a magnetic-grid/marker technology distinct from 'Magnetic Tape' and 'Laser' alone is ambiguous between reflector-based and SLAM-based use, and DS Automotion's whole positioning (ARCOS combining AGV+AMR modes per vehicle/zone) suggests navigation_type genuinely VARIES per base model/zone configuration rather than being a fixed company-wide constant -- left for per-product extraction instead of forcing a guess here.

max_payload.note: Not overwritten. This document is a customer-application case study specifically for insulation-material ('Dämmstoffe') handling, describing an AMADEUS Grip configured for a specific clamping/block-transport task -- may represent a reduced-capacity/specialized configuration rather than the general product's rated max payload. Flagged for Tech Lead judgment rather than assumed to be either right or wrong.
